s0401.literal: The Ren River was channeled, and more than three thousand qing of civilian farmland were restored.
s0401.idiomatic: The Ren River was channeled and more than three thousand qing of farmland was restored.

s0402.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, silk, and other goods according to the annual custom.
s0402.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, coin, silk, and other goods as in the annual custom.

s0403.literal: Princes Yebüke, Yan Temür, and five hundred twenty-nine others were granted sheep and horse prices, eight thousand four hundred fifty-two ingots of notes.
s0403.idiomatic: Princes Yebüke, Yan Temür, and five hundred twenty-nine others received eight thousand four hundred fifty-two ingots of notes for sheep and horse prices.

s0404.literal: Bayadai'r and one thousand three hundred fifty-five others were rewarded for battle merit with one hundred taels of gold, fifteen thousand one hundred taels of silver, one hundred thirty ingots of notes, and naqshi, gold plain silks and cloth, sable and marten furs, leopard robes, and hats and clothing in varying amounts.
s0404.idiomatic: Bayadai'r and one thousand three hundred fifty-five others were rewarded for battle merit with one hundred taels of gold, fifteen thousand one hundred taels of silver, one hundred thirty ingots of notes, and graded naqshi textiles, gold plain silks and cloth, sable and marten furs, leopard robes, and hats and clothing.

s0405.literal: That year famine relief was issued to the hungry in Dongping, Jinan, and other commanderies — twenty-one thousand six hundred seventeen shi of rice, twenty-eight thousand six hundred thirteen shi of millet, and ten thousand one hundred twelve ingots of notes.
s0405.idiomatic: That year the hungry in Dongping, Jinan, and other commanderies received relief of twenty-one thousand six hundred seventeen shi of rice, twenty-eight thousand six hundred thirteen shi of millet, and ten thousand one hundred twelve ingots of notes.

s0406.literal: Thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0406.idiomatic: Thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
